2024-Moshi-Depth-Transformer-Attention.mechanism_en: Moshi separates attention over time from attention within a frame. Its depth Transformer predicts the frame's audio codebooks in order, conditioned on the temporal context and earlier codes.
2024-Moshi-Depth-Transformer-Attention.check_en: The same state_dict and random inputs were used to compare whole-sequence and streaming codebook-by-codebook execution, with both separate and shared weight mappings checked. The maximum absolute difference was 0 in all four configurations, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-MotionAGFormer-Adaptive-Graph-Trans.mechanism_zh: 相邻关节和远处关节提供的线索不同。MotionAGFormer 将通道分给图卷积和自注意力两路，再由当前特征决定两路结果各占多少。
2024-MotionAGFormer-Adaptive-Graph-Trans.mechanism_en: Graph convolution follows nearby joints, while attention can connect farther ones. MotionAGFormer runs the two streams in parallel and learns how to blend their outputs for the current pose features.
2024-MotionAGFormer-Adaptive-Graph-Trans.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0 in all five settings: default adaptive fusion, fixed temporal adjacency, temporal convolution, a graph-convolution-only branch with fixed averaging, and hierarchical branches. The threshold was 1e-5.

2024-PaliGemma-Prefix-Attention.mechanism_zh: 输入图文可以先一起读懂，生成的文字还得逐个写。PaliGemma 让图像和输入文字双向互读，输出位置只看整个前缀与已生成文字。
2024-PaliGemma-Prefix-Attention.mechanism_en: PaliGemma gives the image and prompt full attention within a shared prefix. Generated text can attend to that prefix and earlier output tokens under a causal mask.
2024-PaliGemma-Prefix-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The outputs were identical element by element, with a maximum difference of 0.

2024-Pathformer-Multi-Scale-Dual-Attenti.mechanism_zh: 时间序列里既有短波动，也有跨段趋势。Pathformer 按输入选择片段尺度，在每个选定尺度分别做段内注意力和段间注意力。
2024-Pathformer-Multi-Scale-Dual-Attenti.mechanism_en: Pathformer routes each series to suitable patch sizes. At a chosen scale, one attention step models details inside patches and another connects patches across the series.
2024-Pathformer-Multi-Scale-Dual-Attenti.check_en: The maximum absolute difference across all outputs was 0.

2024-PoSE.mechanism_zh: 训练时不用把长序列全部塞进显存，也能见到远距离位置。PoSE 把短序列切成几段，为各段加不同的位置偏移，制造长上下文里的间隔。
2024-PoSE.mechanism_en: PoSE exposes attention to long position gaps using short training sequences. It splits each sequence into chunks and offsets the position indices of the chunks, leaving the token count unchanged.
2024-PoSE.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official training file. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both sampled sequences and position indices.

2024-Poseidon-ScOT-Attention.mechanism_zh: 偏微分方程的场通常落在大网格上，全局注意力开销高。ScOT 在移位窗口内汇总格点，并用连续的相对位置函数给分数加偏置。
2024-Poseidon-ScOT-Attention.mechanism_en: Poseidon's ScOT backbone uses shifted windows to pass information across a large solution grid. A continuous relative-position bias tells each window's attention how its grid points are arranged.

2024-ProxyCLIP-Proxy-Attention.mechanism_zh: CLIP 的局部特征做分割时，位置之间容易混。ProxyCLIP 从另一视觉模型计算位置相似度和掩码，再用这些权重汇总 CLIP 的值。
2024-ProxyCLIP-Proxy-Attention.mechanism_en: ProxyCLIP borrows spatial correspondences from a separate vision model. It normalizes and masks those similarities, then uses the resulting weights to mix CLIP's value features for segmentation.
2024-ProxyCLIP-Proxy-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-Qwen2-VL-M-RoPE.mechanism_zh: 视频令牌既有时间，也有高和宽。M-RoPE 给查询和键的不同维度分配三种旋转，文字则在三个轴上共用同一个位置编号。
2024-Qwen2-VL-M-RoPE.mechanism_en: Qwen2-VL partitions rotary position channels among time, height, and width. A text token uses the same index on all three axes, while visual tokens can carry distinct coordinates.
2024-Qwen2-VL-M-RoPE.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full model file. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-SAMUS-CNN-Transformer-Interaction.mechanism_zh: SAM 的图像令牌可能漏掉超声里的局部纹理。SAMUS 加一条卷积分支，让 Transformer 令牌作查询，从卷积特征的键和值中补细节。
2024-SAMUS-CNN-Transformer-Interaction.mechanism_en: SAMUS gives the image Transformer access to a parallel convolutional stream. Cross-attention lets its tokens query local ultrasound features that the original visual branch may miss.
2024-SAMUS-CNN-Transformer-Interaction.check_en: The global cross-branch path and the padded window path were compared, for 2 sets. The maximum absolute difference across the 2 sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-SegFormer3D-Efficient-Attention.mechanism_zh: 体素网格一大，注意力就得和大量键打分。SegFormer3D 用三维卷积下采样键和值的输入，查询仍放在原体素网格上。
2024-SegFormer3D-Efficient-Attention.mechanism_en: SegFormer3D reduces the size of the key-value grid with a 3D convolution. Queries stay on the original grid, so each voxel can gather context from a smaller set of locations.
2024-SegFormer3D-Efficient-Attention.check_en: 2 comparison sets covered volumetric downsampling enabled and disabled. The maximum absolute difference across all sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-SepReformer-Downsampled-Self-Attent.mechanism_zh: 分离长语音时，每个采样时刻都去比对太贵。SepReformer 在降采样的时间序列上做自注意力，再由解码器恢复分辨率。
2024-SepReformer-Downsampled-Self-Attent.mechanism_en: SepReformer gathers long-range context on a shorter time sequence. The decoder then lifts the separated representation back to a finer temporal resolution.
2024-SepReformer-Downsampled-Self-Attent.check_en: Two state_dict sets were copied separately. The same position indices and random features were used for comparison, with a maximum absolute difference of 0.

2024-SpatialNet-Full-Band-and-Narrow-Ban.mechanism_zh: 同一说话人的方向线索可在多帧里重复出现。SpatialNet 在每个频带内用自注意力跨帧归集线索，再用全频带层交换不同频带的信息。
2024-SpatialNet-Full-Band-and-Narrow-Ban.mechanism_en: Within each frequency band, SpatialNet attends across frames to group cues from the same speaker. Full-band layers then share evidence between frequencies in the multichannel recording.
2024-SpatialNet-Full-Band-and-Narrow-Ban.check_en: The same state_dict was loaded, and identical random inputs and a temporal causal mask were used for comparison. The maximum absolute difference was 0.

2024-Stormer-Weather-Embedding-Attention.mechanism_zh: 一个气象格点同时有温度、风等不同变量。Stormer 用共享的学习查询在各位置给变量打分，再把它们汇成预报骨干可读的空间令牌。
2024-Stormer-Weather-Embedding-Attention.mechanism_en: Stormer starts with separate tokens for the weather variables at a location. A shared learned query pools those variables into a single spatial token before forecasting.
2024-Stormer-Weather-Embedding-Attention.check_en: The same state_dict was used to compare two grid and patch sizes. One set used only a subset of the registered variables and changed their order. The maximum absolute difference was 0, within the 1e-5 threshold.

2024-StyleID-Style-Injection-Attention.mechanism_zh: 风格迁移时，替换特征容易连原图布局也改掉。StyleID 保留一部分内容查询，用风格图的键和值替换原来的键和值，再调注意力温度。
2024-StyleID-Style-Injection-Attention.mechanism_en: StyleID borrows keys and values from the style image while retaining part of the content query. It also adjusts attention temperature to control how strongly the replacement influences the result.
2024-StyleID-Style-Injection-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the authors' full class. The maximum absolute difference across the three sets of γ and τ was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-TabR-Retrieval-Attention.mechanism_zh: 表格里的相似样本可能已经提供了答案线索。TabR 先在嵌入空间找近邻，再按距离给邻居的标签和特征信息加权。
2024-TabR-Retrieval-Attention.mechanism_en: TabR augments a row's prediction with retrieved examples. Distances in the learned embedding space determine how much label and feature information each neighbor contributes.
2024-TabR-Retrieval-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for all eight CPU output sets, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-TF-Locoformer-Time-Frequency-Attent.mechanism_zh: 语音分离要兼顾长时变化和跨频关系。TF-Locoformer 交替沿时间和频率做注意力，附近的细节交给带门的卷积前馈层。
2024-TF-Locoformer-Time-Frequency-Attent.mechanism_en: TF-Locoformer applies attention separately along time and frequency to capture broad patterns in a mixture. Gated convolutional feed-forward layers handle the local details around each attention block.
2024-TF-Locoformer-Time-Frequency-Attent.check_en: The original TFLocoformerBlock from the pinned commit and a pinned version of RotaryEmbedding were used as references. The maximum absolute difference was 0.

2024-Transolver-Physics-Attention.mechanism_zh: 网格上相隔很远的点也可能处在相似物理状态。Transolver 让点按软权重进入若干物理切片，只在切片令牌之间做注意力，再把结果分回各点。
2024-Transolver-Physics-Attention.mechanism_en: Transolver gives each mesh point soft membership in learned slices that group similar physical states. It runs attention over the slice tokens and redistributes their updated features to the points.
2024-Transolver-Physics-Attention.check_en: The same weights and inputs were used for comparisons on an irregular grid, a 4 × 4 regular grid, and a 2 × 4 × 2 regular grid. The maximum absolute difference was 0, within the 1e-5 threshold.

2024-UDTransNet-DAT.mechanism_zh: U-Net 的跳接特征在语义上可能对不齐。UDTransNet 先在各尺度之间做通道注意力，再给各尺度单独算空间注意力。
2024-UDTransNet-DAT.mechanism_en: UDTransNet lets encoder scales interact before they reach the decoder. It first mixes their channels, then applies spatial attention separately at each scale.
2024-UDTransNet-DAT.check_en: The 2 comparison sets used a maximum resolution of 16 × 16 with 1 layer and 4 heads, and 32 × 32 with 2 layers and 2 heads. The maximum absolute difference across all sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-UNETR.mechanism_zh: 三维分割既要看位置关系，也要看通道关系。UNETR++ 让空间和通道注意力共用查询和键，各自汇总值，最后拼接两路输出。
2024-UNETR.mechanism_en: UNETR++ uses a pair of attention branches to cover space and channels. They reuse the query and key projections, then combine their separate readouts.
2024-UNETR.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official file. The maximum absolute output difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-Uni-Mol2-Pair-Update-Attention.mechanism_zh: 只更新原子令牌会漏掉原子对自身的状态。Uni-Mol2 让成对表示给原子注意力加偏置，再用更新后的原子表示反过来改写成对特征。
2024-Uni-Mol2-Pair-Update-Attention.mechanism_en: Uni-Mol2 keeps a representation for each atom and each pair. Pair features bias token attention, then the updated token features feed back into the pair representation.
2024-Uni-Mol2-Pair-Update-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both outputs, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-VoiceCraft-Span-Infilling-Attention.mechanism_zh: VoiceCraft 把待补语音移到末尾，让因果注意力读到缺口两侧。
2024-VoiceCraft-Span-Infilling-Attention.mechanism_en: A causal decoder normally cannot hear what comes after a gap. VoiceCraft moves the missing span behind the known audio, so generation inside the gap can use both sides.
2024-VoiceCraft-Span-Infilling-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2024-YOLOv10-Partial-Self-Attention.mechanism_zh: 检测器不必让所有通道都做空间注意力。YOLOv10 把通道拆成两路，一路直接走旁路，另一路做空间自注意力和前馈变换，再拼回去。
2024-YOLOv10-Partial-Self-Attention.mechanism_en: YOLOv10's partial self-attention spends computation on only one channel group. The other group bypasses the attention and feed-forward layers, then rejoins the processed features.
2024-YOLOv10-Partial-Self-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official package imported directly. On the CPU, both versions used the same state_dict, random input, and evaluation mode. The maximum absolute difference was 0 in all three configurations, within the 1e-5 threshold.

2025-Aurora-Perceiver-Resampling.mechanism_zh: 气象数据的垂直层数和变量组成会随来源而变。Aurora 用一组潜在查询在每个位置读取多层气象特征，汇成固定长度的表示。
2025-Aurora-Perceiver-Resampling.mechanism_en: Aurora uses learned latent queries to resample atmospheric features at each spatial location. Cross-attention converts varying inputs across vertical levels into a fixed-size representation for the forecast model.
2025-Aurora-Perceiver-Resampling.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0 in both sets, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-CausVid-Block-Causal-Attention.mechanism_zh: 双向去噪要等后面的帧，交互视频等不起。CausVid 将帧分块，块内可以双向互读，跨块只查已经生成的历史。
2025-CausVid-Block-Causal-Attention.mechanism_en: CausVid makes video diffusion autoregressive at the block level. Frames can attend freely within the current block, while cross-block attention reads only the cached past.
2025-CausVid-Block-Causal-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The uncached path used uncompiled FlexAttention. Its outputs had a maximum absolute difference of 0 from the library version.

2025-CorrCLIP-Patch-Correlation-Attentio.mechanism_zh: 分割图里，两个相邻图块可能属于不同对象。CorrCLIP 先用分割掩码圈出可交互的图块，再由外部自监督视觉特征计算相似度权重。
2025-CorrCLIP-Patch-Correlation-Attentio.mechanism_en: CorrCLIP revises both who can interact and how strongly. Segmentation masks constrain patch connections, and a self-supervised vision model supplies similarity scores for the allowed pairs.

2025-DFAT-Dual-Focus-Attention.mechanism_zh: 给两片点云找对应时，无关点会分走权重。DFAT 按几何线索在粗、细两级筛选候选，只让当前点从相关区域聚合信息。
2025-DFAT-Dual-Focus-Attention.mechanism_en: DFAT narrows the attention set at both coarse and fine scales. It uses geometric information to focus each point's feature exchange on likely matches instead of pooling broadly across the other cloud.
2025-DFAT-Dual-Focus-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed because importing ops from the full official package depends on the compiled geotransformer.ext extension. The maximum absolute difference was 0.

2025-DroPE.mechanism_zh: 把语言模型扩到训练长度之外，常要再训长序列。DroPE 移除预训练模型中查询和键上的旋转位置编码，再继续训练，让注意力适应新的打分方式。
2025-DroPE.mechanism_en: DroPE starts from a model trained with rotary positions. It removes the rotations on queries and keys and continues training, allowing longer contexts without long-sequence fine-tuning.

2025-HiDream-I1-Dual-Stream-Attention.mechanism_zh: 文字和图像的投影可以各用一套，注意力仍然一起算。HiDream 先各自生成查询、键和值，将两路拼起来打分，再把更新后的令牌分回图文两路。
2025-HiDream-I1-Dual-Stream-Attention.mechanism_en: HiDream projects text and image tokens with separate parameters. It joins them for one attention calculation, then splits the result back into the two modality streams.
2025-HiDream-I1-Dual-Stream-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the authors' full class. The maximum absolute difference across the two outputs was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-LieRE.mechanism_zh: 固定的二维旋转限制了位置编码能表达的关系。LieRE 对可学习的反对称矩阵取矩阵指数，再用得到的旋转变换查询和键。
2025-LieRE.mechanism_en: LieRE generalizes RoPE's fixed rotations. It exponentiates learned skew-symmetric matrices to obtain position-dependent rotations for queries and keys.
2025-LieRE.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official file. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both rotation matrices and attention outputs.

2025-MCANet-MIR2025-Cross-Axis-Attention.mechanism_zh: 只沿横轴或纵轴取信息，两路可能各看一半。MCANet 用双向交叉注意力让横轴特征和纵轴特征互相读取，补上跨方向的联系。
2025-MCANet-MIR2025-Cross-Axis-Attention.mechanism_en: MCANet connects the horizontal and vertical streams rather than leaving them in separate axial passes. Each stream uses cross-attention to read context from the other.

2025-Med-SA-SD-Trans.mechanism_zh: 二维 SAM 每看一片，就会漏掉切片之间的联系。SD-Trans 将体积特征转置成沿深度的序列，用同一套注意力处理深度和片内两路，再合并。
2025-Med-SA-SD-Trans.mechanism_en: SD-Trans adapts a 2D SAM block to a volume by transposing its features. The same attention weights process within-slice and depth-wise sequences, and the two outputs are combined.
2025-Med-SA-SD-Trans.check_en: 3 comparison sets covered the window path with explicit depth, the global path with implicit depth, and the two-dimensional window path with boundary padding. The maximum absolute difference across the 3 sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-Molmo-Image-Pooling-Attention.mechanism_zh: 高分辨率图像会给语言模型带来很多视觉令牌。Molmo 先把邻近图块分窗，用注意力池化压短每组，再把这些表示送给语言侧。
2025-Molmo-Image-Pooling-Attention.mechanism_en: Molmo reduces the number of visual tokens before handing them to the language model. It groups nearby image patches and uses attention pooling to condense each window.
2025-Molmo-Image-Pooling-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full backbone. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-Qwen3-Next-Partial-Rotary-Gated-Att.mechanism_zh: 有些头总把权重给少数固定位置。Qwen3-Next 只旋转查询和键的部分维度，算完注意力后再用查询生成的逐元素门调节输出。
2025-Qwen3-Next-Partial-Rotary-Gated-Att.mechanism_en: Qwen3-Next rotates only a portion of each query and key head. A query-dependent elementwise gate then scales the attention output, a step designed to reduce attention sinks.
2025-Qwen3-Next-Partial-Rotary-Gated-Att.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official file. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for cosine values, sine values, attention outputs, and attention weights.

2025-Star-Attention.mechanism_zh: 把长提示分给多台机器时，各块需要共享一点上下文。Star Attention 预填充时让各块读同一个锚块，生成时再合并各块上的注意力结果。
2025-Star-Attention.mechanism_en: Star Attention splits long prompts into blocks that can be processed independently. A shared anchor block supplies context during prefill, and decoding merges attention over the distributed caches.
2025-Star-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official implementation. The supplementary comparison ran the original merge function from the pinned commit with the same inputs. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both decoding outputs and logsumexp.

2025-TabICL-Row-Embedding-Attention.mechanism_zh: 直接在整张大表上交替做行列注意力，计算会越积越多。TabICL 先沿列给各单元格补上下文，再沿行汇成定长向量，交给预测模型。
2025-TabICL-Row-Embedding-Attention.mechanism_en: TabICL first contextualizes cells along their columns, then pools each row into a fixed-size embedding. The prediction Transformer works with those row embeddings instead of repeatedly revisiting the whole table.
2025-TabICL-Row-Embedding-Attention.check_en: The same random tables covered pre- and post-normalization, training and inference, and different context lengths and valid column counts. Column and row outputs were compared under eight conditions. All maximum absolute differences were 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-TabPFNv2-Row-Column-Attention.mechanism_zh: 预测新样本时，表里的已标注行都可作参考。TabPFNv2 交替沿字段轴和样本轴做注意力，让待预测行在样本轴上读取训练行。
2025-TabPFNv2-Row-Column-Attention.mechanism_en: TabPFNv2 alternates attention across features and across rows. A query row can use the labeled training rows as context for predicting its missing target.
2025-TabPFNv2-Row-Column-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference across ten CPU output sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-TQNet-Temporal-Query-Attention.mechanism_zh: 变量之间的关系可能随周期阶段而变。TQNet 按样本所处的周期位置选取可学习查询，用当前输入生成键和值，再沿变量轴加权。
2025-TQNet-Temporal-Query-Attention.mechanism_en: TQNet shares a set of learned queries across examples, shifting them according to the period. Keys and values come from the current sample, so variable attention combines recurring patterns with what is happening now.
2025-TQNet-Temporal-Query-Attention.check_en: Both sides used identical random CPU inputs, covering period wraparound, four combinations of ablation switches, and RevIN on and off. The maximum absolute difference across 12 comparisons was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-Transolver-Adaptive-Physics-Attenti.mechanism_zh: 大网格里，各点属于哪个物理切片，确定程度并不一样。Transolver++ 给各点学出分配温度，再把各分块的加权贡献汇成切片令牌做注意力。
2025-Transolver-Adaptive-Physics-Attenti.mechanism_en: Transolver++ learns a local temperature for assigning mesh points to physical slices. It combines slice contributions across partitions before applying attention to the resulting slice tokens.
2025-Transolver-Adaptive-Physics-Attenti.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0, within the 1e-5 threshold.

2025-USEF-TFGridNet-Cross-Attention.mechanism_zh: 只用一条说话人向量，会压掉参考语音的帧级线索。USEF 用混合语音查询参考语音的帧特征，从中提取当前帧所需的目标说话人信息。
2025-USEF-TFGridNet-Cross-Attention.mechanism_en: USEF-TSE compares the mixture with a reference recording frame by frame through cross-attention. The extracted voice features guide separation without first compressing the reference into a speaker embedding.
2025-USEF-TFGridNet-Cross-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0.0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2025-Wan2-1-Image-Text-Decoupled-Attenti.mechanism_zh: 参考图和文字提供不同线索。Wan 用同一组视频查询分别读取图像和文本，两路权重各做一次 softmax，再把读出的结果相加。
2025-Wan2-1-Image-Text-Decoupled-Attenti.mechanism_en: Wan gives the reference image and text separate cross-attention paths. The same video queries read both, but each source has its own softmax before the two results are added.
2025-Wan2-1-Image-Text-Decoupled-Attenti.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full authors' class and CUDA kernels. The comparison used identical state_dict and inputs. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both full-length and variable-length inputs, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-AnchorSplat-Sample-Attention.mechanism_zh: 场景的锚点多，每个都和全部锚点打分会很贵。AnchorSplat 保留所有查询，只用序列前部的一组采样位置生成键和值。
2026-AnchorSplat-Sample-Attention.mechanism_en: AnchorSplat's Gaussian decoder keeps every query while reducing the set it reads. The sampled prefix supplies keys and values, shrinking the score matrix used to reconstruct a scene.
2026-AnchorSplat-Sample-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official file imported directly. The maximum absolute difference across 4 comparisons was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-AutoGaze-Block-Causal-Video-Attenti.mechanism_zh: 视频里许多图块和上一帧差不多。AutoGaze 的重建注意力允许同帧图块互看，也能读过去的帧，掩码挡住未来帧和补齐位置。
2026-AutoGaze-Block-Causal-Video-Attenti.mechanism_en: AutoGaze learns which video patches can be skipped using a reconstruction branch. Its attention mask permits all tokens within a frame to interact and lets them read earlier frames, while excluding future frames and padding.
2026-AutoGaze-Block-Causal-Video-Attenti.check_en: Both sides loaded the same state_dict and used identical CPU inputs. The maximum absolute difference across 6 comparisons was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-CTCal-Cross-Timestep-Attention-Cali.mechanism_zh: 噪声很重时，文字和图像位置的对应还没成形。CTCal 把低噪声时步的交叉注意力图当训练目标，校准高噪声时步的图文对应。
2026-CTCal-Cross-Timestep-Attention-Cali.mechanism_en: Text-to-image alignment is clearer at lower noise levels. CTCal uses the cross-attention maps from those timesteps as supervision for noisier stages of training.
2026-CTCal-Cross-Timestep-Attention-Cali.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0 for the loss and logs, and 0 for the gradient of the student attention map. The threshold was 1e-5.

2026-DHSA-LLM.mechanism_zh: 长上下文里，算遍所有历史令牌太费内存。DHSA 先预测各块的重要性，再把块级评分传到令牌层，决定哪些连接值得计算。
2026-DHSA-LLM.mechanism_en: DHSA starts by predicting which context chunks matter to the current input. It uses those chunk-level estimates to select token-level interactions, cutting the cost of attention on long prompts.

2026-FlashVSR-Locality-Constrained-Spars.mechanism_zh: 视频超分逐帧读完整历史，处理速度跟不上输入。FlashVSR 把候选限制在流式邻域内，并在邻域里只保留选中的块来算注意力。
2026-FlashVSR-Locality-Constrained-Spars.mechanism_en: FlashVSR limits attention to a streaming neighborhood for video super-resolution. Sparse block selection within that neighborhood avoids recomputing interactions with much of the video history.
2026-FlashVSR-Locality-Constrained-Spars.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the original official CUDA class. Four checks covered the block operator, regular forward pass, first streaming segment, and continuation with a cache. The maximum absolute difference was 2.68221e-7, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-Gemma-4-Shared-KV-Attention.mechanism_zh: 每层都留一份键和值，长上下文会占去不少缓存。Gemma 4 让指定层沿用前层的键值，局部窗口和全局注意力各找同类型的来源。
2026-Gemma-4-Shared-KV-Attention.mechanism_en: Gemma 4 lets designated layers reuse cached keys and values from earlier layers. Local and global attention read from separate sharing sources, so each keeps its own context pattern.
2026-Gemma-4-Shared-KV-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official file. The maximum absolute difference was 0 across the four layers' outputs and weights and both types of shared keys and values.

2026-GRAPE.mechanism_zh: 相对位置既能改查询和键，也能直接改分数。GRAPE 用群表示统一两种做法，一种旋转查询与键，一种把位置项加到注意力分数。
2026-GRAPE.mechanism_en: GRAPE uses group actions to express relative position in two forms. One applies rotations to queries and keys, and the other adds a position-dependent bias directly to the logits.
2026-GRAPE.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official file. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both attention implementations.

2026-IET-Individualized-Exploratory-Atte.mechanism_zh: 同一组图块里，各图块想看的位置未必相同。IET 让每个查询按自己的内容独立选候选，再在这组候选上计算注意力。
2026-IET-Individualized-Exploratory-Atte.mechanism_en: IET gives each image token its own attention neighborhood. It selects candidates according to the query's content, so tokens in the same patch group need not read the same locations.

2026-Inf-Dehaze-IBSSA.mechanism_zh: 超大图逐块去雾容易留下接缝。IBSSA 按局部敏感哈希重排查询和键，让相似特征聚到一起，只在排序后的块内和相邻块间算注意力。
2026-Inf-Dehaze-IBSSA.mechanism_en: Independent crops can lose the broader structure of haze. IBSSA sorts queries and keys by locality-sensitive hashing, then computes attention within each sorted block and between adjacent blocks.

2026-k-MIP-Graph-Attention.mechanism_zh: 图注意力要找相关节点，没必要把所有节点对的分数存下来。k-MIP 给每个查询找内积最高的 k 个键，再只从这些节点汇总值。
2026-k-MIP-Graph-Attention.mechanism_en: Each graph query retrieves the k keys with the largest inner products. Attention pools only those nodes, avoiding the need to materialize an all-pairs score matrix.
2026-k-MIP-Graph-Attention.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. It covered all candidates and random preselection, with a maximum absolute difference of 2.38418579e-07.

2026-LimiX-2M-Readout-Aligned-Attention.mechanism_zh: 大表需要从其他样本取线索，也需要看同一行内的字段。LimiX-2M 先沿样本轴汇总，再混合字段，最后用注意力池化读出目标表示。
2026-LimiX-2M-Readout-Aligned-Attention.mechanism_en: LimiX-2M first gathers context across examples and then mixes the fields within each row. Attention pooling forms the target representation for the final readout.
2026-LimiX-2M-Readout-Aligned-Attention.check_en: The encoding, diagnostic weights, and original target readout were compared, for 11 tensors in total. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-LinearNO-Physics-Attention.mechanism_zh: 把格点分进物理切片后，还可以省掉切片间那次显式注意力。LinearNO 将分配和回读重写为线性注意力，先汇总键和值，再应用查询。
2026-LinearNO-Physics-Attention.mechanism_en: LinearNO rewrites Physics-Attention as linear attention. It aggregates keys and values before applying queries, dispensing with a separate attention map between physical slices.

2026-LongLive-Frame-Attention-Sink.mechanism_zh: 长视频只读滑窗，最初的场景容易被遗忘。LongLive 在近期帧之外保留起始帧供注意力读取，换文字提示时还会刷新缓存。
2026-LongLive-Frame-Attention-Sink.mechanism_en: LongLive keeps a frame-level attention sink alongside a short sliding window. The initial frame remains available as recent frames come and go, and the cache can be refreshed when the prompt changes.
2026-LongLive-Frame-Attention-Sink.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference was 0 in both scenarios: sliding-window eviction and cache refresh after a prompt change. The threshold was 1e-5.

2026-LTGA-Edgewise-Tsallis-Attention.mechanism_zh: 用固定 softmax，每条邻边都遵守同一套归一化形状。LTGA 根据边两端的特征预测 Tsallis 指数，让注意力在不同边上采用不同稀疏程度。
2026-LTGA-Edgewise-Tsallis-Attention.mechanism_en: LTGA learns the shape of attention rather than fixing it to softmax. Its edgewise variant predicts a Tsallis index from each edge's endpoints, allowing heavier tails or sparser weights where the graph calls for them.
2026-LTGA-Edgewise-Tsallis-Attention.check_en: Both sides loaded the same state_dict and used identical CPU random inputs. The maximum absolute difference across 12 comparisons was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-LTX-2-Audio-Video-Cross-Attention.mechanism_zh: 视频动作和声音要对上时间。LTX-2 让音频与视频各保留去噪支路，两边用带时间位置的交叉注意力向对方取信息。
2026-LTX-2-Audio-Video-Cross-Attention.mechanism_en: LTX-2 denoises audio and video in separate streams that can query each other. The bidirectional cross-attention uses temporal position information so visual events and sounds can share aligned context.
2026-LTX-2-Audio-Video-Cross-Attention.check_en: Both paths loaded the same cross-attention state_dict and used the same PyTorch SDPA. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-MoGA-Memory-Attention.mechanism_zh: 画面受损时，跟踪器还得找回同一个对象。MoGA 从记忆中的对象指针算门权重，按对象选择 SAM 2 记忆注意力的低秩投影增量。
2026-MoGA-Memory-Attention.mechanism_en: MoGA conditions the memory attention on the object being tracked. Object pointers gate the low-rank adapter components used in SAM 2's attention projections, adapting the lookup when the video is degraded.
2026-MoGA-Memory-Attention.check_en: For comparison, the LoRA B matrix was assigned nonzero weights before sharing the state_dict. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both inputs: two object pointers and no pointers.

2026-Moonshine-Streaming-Local-Attention.mechanism_zh: 语音识别若等全句再做注意力，就难以边说边出字。Moonshine 只让当前帧在流式调度给出的局部上下文里取信息。
2026-Moonshine-Streaming-Local-Attention.mechanism_en: Moonshine keeps streaming speech recognition local. The scheduler supplies each segment with nearby context, and attention reads within that region without waiting for the complete utterance.
2026-Moonshine-Streaming-Local-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0 for both output features and attention weights, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-Music-Flamingo-Audio-Text-Rotary-At.mechanism_zh: 音乐的节奏和结构得有时间坐标。Music Flamingo 在音频令牌进入语言解码器前，按音频时间给它们加旋转位置编码。
2026-Music-Flamingo-Audio-Text-Rotary-At.mechanism_en: Music Flamingo gives audio tokens a rotary encoding tied to their timing before the language decoder reads them. This lets the input representation carry temporal structure into music understanding.
2026-Music-Flamingo-Audio-Text-Rotary-At.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full model file. The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-PEARL-Procrustes-Attention.mechanism_zh: 分割时，CLIP 最后一层的查询和键可能落在方向不同的特征子空间。PEARL 先用正交 Procrustes 旋转对齐两者，再算注意力分数。
2026-PEARL-Procrustes-Attention.mechanism_en: PEARL changes the last self-attention block in CLIP. An orthogonal Procrustes transform rotates the keys toward the query subspace before the model scores patch correspondences.

2026-ProxyAttn.mechanism_zh: 为每个头先算满分数再找稀疏块，筛选本身也很贵。ProxyAttn 把相似头池化成代表头，用代表分数估计各头应保留哪些块。
2026-ProxyAttn.mechanism_en: ProxyAttn uses pooled representative heads to predict which blocks matter. Several heads can share that cheap estimate before the sparse attention step applies their individual block budgets.

2026-RATE-Recurrent-Memory-Attention.mechanism_zh: 只看一截轨迹，智能体可能忘掉早先观察到的线索。RATE 把记忆令牌和历史隐状态带到下一段，让新一段的注意力还能读取过去。
2026-RATE-Recurrent-Memory-Attention.mechanism_en: RATE breaks a long trajectory into segments while carrying memory forward. Attention in the next segment can revisit memory tokens and prior hidden states when current observations are ambiguous.
2026-RATE-Recurrent-Memory-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-SAM-3-Promptable-Concept-Attention.mechanism_zh: 一句概念提示可以指向画面中的多个对象。SAM 3 在解码器里让目标查询读取文字或几何提示，找出所有匹配实例并预测掩码。
2026-SAM-3-Promptable-Concept-Attention.mechanism_en: SAM 3 treats a concept prompt as a request for every matching instance. Its detection queries read text or geometric prompt features before returning instance masks.
2026-SAM-3-Promptable-Concept-Attention.check_en: The comparison covered four combinations of prompts, image masks, the presence token, and DAC. The maximum absolute output difference was 4.76837158e-07, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-ScoPE-LLM.mechanism_zh: 长序列的位置关系也可以写进掩码。ScoPE 给不同头设定按指数增长的回看范围，只让各头读取自己范围内的历史。
2026-ScoPE-LLM.mechanism_en: ScoPE encodes order in the visibility pattern of attention. Heads get exponentially increasing look-back windows, so different heads can track dependencies over different distances.
2026-ScoPE-LLM.check_en: The numerical comparison directly ran the original function and window function from the pinned commit, and used the original Transformers function for grouped keys and values. With the same state_dict and random inputs, the maximum absolute difference was 0 for outputs and weights in all four settings.

2026-SeerAttention-R.mechanism_zh: 解码时每次只来少量新查询，没必要重算全部历史块。SeerAttention-R 用自蒸馏训练出的门直接给当前查询挑键值块，省去查询池化。
2026-SeerAttention-R.mechanism_en: SeerAttention-R predicts which cached blocks an autoregressive query will need. Its self-distilled gate reads the query directly and selects the blocks used for sparse attention.
2026-SeerAttention-R.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed against the full official path. The block masks were identical element by element, and the maximum absolute difference for the compressed keys and remainder cache was 0.

2026-Selective-RoPE.mechanism_zh: 固定 RoPE 只按位置转动查询和键。Selective RoPE 从输入决定每步转多少，也可把这些旋转和遗忘门一起写进线性注意力的状态更新。
2026-Selective-RoPE.mechanism_en: Selective RoPE makes rotary angles depend on the input. In gated linear attention, those rotations can be folded into a recurrent update alongside the forgetting gate.
2026-Selective-RoPE.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. With the same parameters and random inputs, the maximum absolute difference across three settings and cached continuation was 1.43051147e-06.

2026-SparseD.mechanism_zh: 不同去噪轮次里，同一个注意力头常看相似的位置。SparseD 前期做稠密注意力，后期按头沿用预先选出的稀疏连接。
2026-SparseD.mechanism_en: SparseD keeps full attention during the early denoising steps. Later steps reuse a sparse pattern for each head, taking advantage of the tendency for a head to revisit the same positions.

2026-TabICLv2-Scalable-Softmax-Attention.mechanism_zh: 参考表越长，普通 softmax 越容易把权重摊薄。TabICLv2 按可见样本数缩放注意力分数，再做 softmax，让重要样本仍能分到较多权重。
2026-TabICLv2-Scalable-Softmax-Attention.mechanism_en: As a table grows, ordinary softmax can spread attention across too many examples. TabICLv2 scales the logits with context length before normalizing, helping a query retain sharper preferences.
2026-TabICLv2-Scalable-Softmax-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference across eighteen CPU forward-pass sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-TiRex-2-Asymmetric-Group-Attention.mechanism_zh: 未来的天气预报可以给销量预测参考，未来销量本身却不能泄露。TiRex-2 的组内掩码让目标读协变量，并阻止反向读取。
2026-TiRex-2-Asymmetric-Group-Attention.mechanism_en: TiRex-2 lets a forecast use covariates that are known in advance. Its asymmetric mask allows target queries to read covariates while blocking covariate queries from reading the targets.
2026-TiRex-2-Asymmetric-Group-Attention.check_en: Both sides loaded the same state_dict and used identical random CPU inputs. The maximum absolute difference across 8 comparisons was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-Transolver-3-Dynamic-Slice-Attentio.mechanism_zh: 大网格装不进一次聚合。Transolver-3 先在几何分块内把点汇成物理切片，再在块间分享切片上下文，最后把结果分回网格。
2026-Transolver-3-Dynamic-Slice-Attentio.mechanism_en: Transolver-3 tiles a large geometry and forms physical slice tokens within each tile. Attention shares context across the tiles before the results return to the mesh points.
2026-Transolver-3-Dynamic-Slice-Attentio.check_en: The tiled comparison used three tiles of 3, 8, and 5 points. The maximum absolute difference was 0, within the 1e-5 threshold.

2026-UCAN-Hedgehog-Attention.mechanism_zh: 小窗能保住附近纹理，复原远处重复结构还需要更大范围。UCAN 将窗口注意力和 Hedgehog 线性注意力组合，后者先汇总变换后的键和值。
2026-UCAN-Hedgehog-Attention.mechanism_en: UCAN uses window attention for nearby texture and Hedgehog attention for longer-range structure. The linear branch pools transformed keys with values before applying queries, avoiding a dense global score map.
2026-UCAN-Hedgehog-Attention.check_en: The maximum absolute difference across the four CPU forward-pass sets was 0, with a threshold of 1e-5.

2026-UniCorrn-Universal-Correspondence-A.mechanism_zh: 图像与点云不必各用一套匹配模型。UniCorrn 用共享的注意力层比较两侧特征，让图像、点云或图像与点云都能沿同一路径找对应。
2026-UniCorrn-Universal-Correspondence-A.mechanism_en: UniCorrn uses the same attention-based matcher for image pairs, point-cloud pairs, and mixed pairs. The matcher compares features across the two inputs to find geometric correspondences.
2026-UniCorrn-Universal-Correspondence-A.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed because the full official package requires xformers, which is missing from the current environment. The maximum absolute difference was 0 in both checks.

2026-VidEoMT-Temporal-Query-Propagation.mechanism_zh: 逐帧分割容易把同一对象当成新对象。VidEoMT 将上一帧的实例查询和当前的可学习查询融合，再与当前图像令牌一起做自注意力。
2026-VidEoMT-Temporal-Query-Propagation.mechanism_en: VidEoMT carries queries forward from the previous frame to preserve object identity. It blends those queries with learned ones, then lets them attend alongside the current image tokens.
2026-VidEoMT-Temporal-Query-Propagation.check_en: No numerical comparison was performed. The maximum absolute difference was 0 for the joint tokens from three frames and the propagated queries from the final frame.
